title: 組織のContent Exclusion・Logging統制が新しいAgent Surfaceへ未実装のまま展開され、除外対象コードや生API BodyがContext・Logへ流入する
summary: Enterprise data-governance policies are enforced on older product surfaces but silently unenforced on newer agentic ones until later patched. GitHub changelog 2026-09-02/2026-09-04: 'Copilot app and CLI now honor content exclusions, keeping sensitive code out of context across agentic workflows' — content exclusions reached GA in Copilot app/CLI only in this window, implying agentic workflows previously pulled excluded (sensitive) code into model context despite org policy configured for the IDE surfaces. Same-week sibling in Claude Code v2.1.253: 'Fixed project settings enabling detailed tracing or raw API body logging without proper controls' — repository-checked project settings could enable raw API body logging (prompts, code, potentially secrets written to logs) without the control gates that govern such telemetry. Mechanism: policy enforcement (exclusions, telemetry controls) is implemented per-surface, and fast-shipping agent surfaces launch before inheriting it, creating a window where admins believe policy applies but the agent surface ignores it. Related to I05/I06/I14 as impact, but the mechanism (per-surface policy-enforcement lag) is not separately cataloged. Medium confidence: prior non-enforcement is implied by the GA wording, not documented as an advisory.
